title: Lawmakers invest in tech, AI, and crypto as new rules for the industries are on their agenda
title_zh: 立法者投资科技、人工智能和加密货币，行业新规则已提上议程
summary: As Congress debates new regulations around artificial intelligence and cryptocurrency, lawmakers' stock portfolios have surged in recent years toward investments in these sectors.
summary_zh: 随着国会就人工智能和加密货币的新法规进行辩论，立法者的股票投资组合近年来激增，转向这些领域的投资。
